characters.name: Чайлитка
characters.description: Улитка с чайником вместо раковины. Пыхтит паром и ускоряется на чайной тяге.
characters.concept: A delightfully stubborn mint-green snail whose entire shell is a round coral-pink glazed ceramic teapot, organically carried as its spiral-shell replacement. The teapot has a short broad upward-curved pouring spout, a thick loop handle behind, a domed lid with a tiny turquoise knob. The snail itself has two tall rounded eyestalks with huge alert eyes, a soft wide smiling muzzle and a muscular single rippling foot, leaving a tiny teal paint smear. Little curls of steam from the spout hint at its absurd steam boost. Rich fine crackle glaze, cream rim, soft wet snail skin. The snail's head is distinct from the pot, no face painted on the teapot. Full handle and spout fit in frame. No umbrella, no cup-headed human.

characters.description: Живая кассета с глазами-катушками. Лента закручивается в ритмичный красочный вихрь.
characters.concept: An animated chunky violet audio cassette creature with a softly rounded casing and TWO big expressive reel-eyes visible through circular clear windows. The eyes are cassette reels with bright pupils in the hubs. Little wide grin along the lower opening, two small bendy orange cable arms, four short rounded rubber roller-feet. A single loose brown magnetic-tape ribbon curls from one rear corner into a broad playful tail, attached and clearly readable rather than tangled. Matte purple plastic, light scuffs, visible screws, transparent amber reel windows and warm cream edge accents. Cheeky jaunty pose with one arm waving. Absolutely no lettering, no cassette label, no brand, no humanoid robot helmet, no separate music player.

characters.concept: A fuzzy round bumblebee whose oversized abdomen is a beautifully glowing honey-yellow lightbulb, attached to a small charcoal-and-amber fuzzy thorax. Its face is friendly and comically earnest with large dark brown eyes, two short curled antennae and tiny smiling muzzle. Two broad small translucent wings with subtle curved veins on its back, exactly six short dark fuzzy insect legs, all attached to the thorax; two forelegs held like bashful hands. The bulb abdomen has warm luminous glass, a softly visible coiled filament and a brushed brass collar where it joins the body, NOT a screw base sticking out as a stinger. Full creature gently hovering. Soft fuzz vs luminous glass contrast, no harsh bloom obscuring outline. No bee brand mascot or existing character features.

characters.name: Носкоракет
characters.description: Непоседливый носок-ракета с хвостом-прищепкой. Надувается и выстреливает вперёд.
characters.concept: A single living knitted sock shaped into a plump soft rocket creature. The curved round sock toe points diagonally forward as the nose of the creature and has a tiny integrated air nozzle beneath it. Two lively turquoise eyes and raised brows sit on the upper instep; a goofy grin in the knit below. Thick turned-over ribbed cuff at the rear, exactly two small folded-fabric fins at its sides and one little wooden clothespin clipped to the cuff as tail stabilizer. Two short folded knitted feet extend below so it can stand. Warm coral and cream broad sock stripes with teal heel patch, detailed yarn loops, slight pilling. A small puff of pale cyan air under the toe suggests harmless air propulsion. No real rocket, no metal aircraft, no flames, no extra sock, no human inside the sock.

characters.description: Броненосец с панцирем-круассаном. Сворачивается в хрустящий шар и прокатывается по планете.
characters.concept: A cheerful squat armadillo with a huge croissant-pastry armored back. Its coherent curved shell consists of overlapping crescent croissant layers, golden crisp laminated pastry with finely toasted ridges and soft flour in creases. Small dusky-purple armadillo face with long soft tapered nose, tiny rounded ears, bright amber eyes and a delighted lopsided smile. Four short sturdy purple scaled legs with blunt ivory claws and a tapered segmented pastry-covered tail curling behind. All four feet visible, head peeking out proudly from shell. The shell should look like armor made of one croissant, NOT many pastries piled on an animal. Original lovable animal anatomy; no hedgehog spikes or turtle shell geometry, no logos.

Strong barrel body, coherent sculpted anatomy, no body made out of a magnet. Fine soft purple fur, satin nose, scratched painted magnet metal. A comic braced forward leaning pose. No boar tusks, no aggressive weapon, no detached floating parts.

Detailed leather creases, brass rivets, glossy enamel, not a long box or train. No instrument keys with lettering, no separate musician or additional creature.

characters.description: Муравьед-пылесос с хвостом-щёточкой. Втягивает разноцветные искры и выдыхает облачко краски.
characters.concept: A fuzzy little ginger anteater fused naturally with a rounded turquoise vacuum-cleaner canister body. Distinct anteater head with long narrow corrugated flexible hose snout ending in a broad soft brush suction nozzle; two lively amber eyes and small round ears above the hose base. Four short soft-furred animal legs support the compact oval glossy canister torso, a little orange power button embedded on top, no lettering. Long fluffy striped ginger-and-cream tail sweeping upward with its tip shaped into soft brush bristles. No separate vacuum machine following it, all one animal. One front paw lifted, inquisitive snout pointing down toward a tiny cyan paint sparkle. Beautiful fuzzy ears and tail, glossy enamel body, ribbed rubber hose; no real electrical plug in mouth, no branded mascot, no human legs.

characters.name: Попкорн-Пых
characters.description: Рыба-попкорн: от удивления раздувается и разбрасывает пушистые хлопья краски.
characters.concept: A comically surprised round pufferfish whose puffed spherical body is covered in many soft irregular popped-corn tufts rather than sharp spikes. Main face is warm buttery yellow with enormous startled teal eyes, puffed cheeks and small round open pink mouth. Golden-white popcorn clusters form a coherent fluffy sculpted body, with toasted kernels visible only in a few creases. Two broad side fins and a small fan tail are made of layered fresh light-green corn husk leaves. Two tiny folded husk fins beneath the body act as funny standing feet; the creature hovers just above these so all appendages are readable. Some pink and cyan paint tints on a handful of popcorn lobes. Original happy pufferfish, no bear body, no branded popcorn carton, no text, no additional loose popcorn covering silhouette.
